name: cauldron
note: the cauldron (docs/47 section 3, #481): one prop with its fire under it, burning logs as the oven does and cooking nothing (`cooks` false: it boils no water and bakes nothing), brewing only while lit. The witch's at the mere is the map's (tools/mapgen/valley.py), never carried and not a village station; your own is the Cauldron item set down with Place (src/setdown.js) and picked up while it is out and empty. A dev box until its art is drawn
